title: Advanced R&D features
tables: Feature
Research question
Boundary before any claim
Pheno-to-geno inference
Can phenotypic time-series prioritize likely resistance mechanisms?
Research triage only; confirm with molecular/reference methods.
Zone-to-MIC modeling
Can paired datasets estimate MIC distributions from zone and kinetic features?
Not a replacement for direct MIC; prospective external validation required.
Early AST / RAST assistance
Can imaging automate validated early reading windows?
Use method-specific RAST rules and permitted organism/drug/time combinations [S13].
VOC-biological fusion
Do VOC patterns add predictive value beyond images and conditions?
Application-specific controlled studies; no standalone species ID.
3D phenotype models
Can surface topography quantify mucoidy, biofilm or stress response?
Profilometer calibration and biological ground truth required.
Digital-twin prediction
Can early trajectories forecast later endpoints?
Decision support only until locked, validated and regulated for a defined use.
Federated fleet learning
Can sites improve models without centralizing sensitive data?
Governance, drift control, security, consent and independent validation.
Automated colony picking
Can coordinates guide safe, traceable downstream workup?
Containment, purity, carryover and recovery validation; future robotics.
